title: A little access. More possibilities.
lead: Choose what you want to enable. Everything here is optional.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.reason: Know when a model is ready or a long task finishes.
notifications.detail: Atomic Chat can show a notification when a download completes. You can change this later in system settings.

microphone.title: Microphone
microphone.reason: Speak your prompts and use voice conversations.
microphone.detail: Microphone access is used only when you start recording. Text chat works without it.

warning.title: Continue without permissions?
warning.body: Voice input and download notifications stay off until you allow them. You can enable access later in Settings.
